findings.claim: Original 004572B0 registers actual native VCF-constructed class-1 GTSi and bus roots at the first 0x78-byte active-world entry 00542830, with original 0045ED00 recursive reference acquisition; observed root reference count rises 3→4 and active count becomes 1.
findings.limitations: VM root/transform and runtime state are controlled; zero registered sphere floats not trusted as retail world bounds; callbacks not initialized through complete retail startup.

findings.claim: Original 00457FF0 on both registered roots calls the original frustum code, record allocator 00490590 and spatial bin insertion 0048FE10 to emit separate type-6 root and type-10 child records under accepted synthetic frustum. The type-10 insertion is from distinct callsite 0048F4A3, not duplicate type-6 submission. Rejected frustum emits neither record.
findings.limitations: Artificial camera and near/far bucket range; original type-10 semantic purpose remains unresolved; Ghidra x87 not hardware parity.

findings.claim: The unmodified producer-authored type-6 root work record is consumed by original 0048FAC0, dispatched via 0048F4C0 into 0045D530, and enters real child GEO builder 0045CBE0; zero polygons reach 00471FD0 under the controlled view.
findings.limitations: No actual raster, pixel decode or naturally initialized game camera. No claim that a real vehicle renders zero polygons.

findings.claim: Original 00457420 unregisters the live GTSi or bus root entry created by 004572B0: its owner slot becomes null, global active count decrements 1→0, and root reference count drops 4→3. A subsequent unmodified 004572B0 reuses 00542830 and restores count/refcount to 1/4.
findings.limitations: Reference lifecycle tested only for synthetic per-vehicle state, with no full mission/AI callbacks, retail game heap or physical world teardown.

findings.claim: Authentic game-loop camera/view initialization, real-world transformed radius numerical validity, the type-10 record-specific consumer, renderer clip/draw and pixel acquisition remain unexecuted and not characterized at full retail-frame fidelity.
findings.limitations: Do not extrapolate the controlled renderer scratch setup to actual retail gameplay graphics.
